item.title: Adding Member Clusters via Proxy Connection
item.description: This section describes how to add a member cluster via proxy connection. If the host cluster cannot access the Kubernetes API service of the member cluster, you can set up the member cluster to connect to the tower service exposed by the host cluster to add the member cluster. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the host cluster. The KubeSphere Multi-Cluster Agent Connection extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.
